title: #BCTalent in APAC: Bridging the Talent Gap Together

chapters.title: Scaling challenges and BC Talent availability
Program impact on team construction and onboarding

features.name: BC Talent program
features.description: A program launched in Australia that helps Business Central partners recruit and train consultants with industry experience and Business Central skills. The program brings candidates up to speed quickly and supports both recruitment and reskilling efforts.

quotes.text: We're constantly competing for the same resources which made scaling our team almost impossible.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the core business problem the BC Talent program addresses - severe resource scarcity in the talent market.

quotes.text: When we first heard it was available in Australia, we had to jump on the opportunity.
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms the program is generally available in Australia, demonstrating market demand and partner enthusiasm.

quotes.text: This program is changing the way that we construct our business central teams.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates significant impact on partner hiring and team structure strategies.

quotes.text: It enables us to get consultants that have industry experience and also are trained up in business central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the unique value proposition of finding experienced consultants with BC skills.

quotes.text: It brings consultants up to speed really quickly. It also helps taking the pressure off the existing team
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the main operational benefit for partners: new consultants get up to speed fast and the existing team has less to carry.

quotes.text: I see a future where the BC Talent program is a critical component of the enablement strategy of all business central partners.
quotes.why_it_matters: Articulates the strategic vision for the program as a foundational partner capability.
